en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard view over the rooftops of a small historic town with wooden houses. In the middle distance stands a white church with a tall, dark, domed bell tower, and beside it a large, steep-roofed cathedral-like building. Trees surround the church complex, and low hills are visible in the background. In the sky area at the upper left, printed text reads "Gamla Borgå. Wanha Porvoo."
